import csv
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root=Path('.')
evidence=root/'experiments/results/mesh_inten_kitti_coverage'
summary=json.loads((evidence/'summary.json').read_text())
with (root/'docs/assets/paper/paper_ratio_table.csv').open() as f:
    table=list(csv.DictReader(f))
source_commit=summary['input_commit']
counts={}
for method,info in summary['methods'].items():
    selected=[row for row in table if row['method']==method]
    assert len(selected)==11
    for row in info['rows']:
        seq=row['sequence']
        aggregate=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',source_commit+':'+row['aggregate']]))
        variant=next(v for v in aggregate['variants'] if v['id']==info['variant'])
        assert variant['args']==info['args'] and '--no-gt-seed' in variant['args']
        with (root/f'experiments/reference_data/kitti_seq_{seq}_full_gt.csv').open() as f:
            expected=sum(1 for _ in csv.DictReader(f))
        assert variant['frames']==expected
        t=next(t for t in selected if t['sequence']==seq)
        assert t['repo_metric']=='kitti_rte' and t['repo_best_variant']==info['variant']
        assert t['repo_pool_size']==t['selected_from_n']=='1'
        assert t['repo_best_rpe_pct']==f"{row['fixed_rte_pct']:.3f}"
        assert t['repo_best_ratio']==f"{row['fixed_ratio']:.2f}"
        if row['above_twice_paper']:
            assert (root/row['diagnostics_path']).is_file()
        if seq not in ['00','07']:
            run=root/'experiments/results/runs'/Path(row['aggregate']).stem/info['variant']
            s=json.loads((run/'summary.json').read_text())
            assert s['num_frames']==s['total_pcd_frames']==s['used_gt_pose_count']==expected
    counts[method]={'full_sequences':len(selected),'frames':[r['frames'] for r in info['rows']],
                    'above_twice_paper':info['above_twice_paper']}
old=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','d1b7288ff46964bde86ef15ab34b2ae8b4f389da:evaluation/data/paper_reported_numbers.json']))
new=json.loads((root/'evaluation/data/paper_reported_numbers.json').read_text())
for method in old['methods']:
    assert old['methods'][method].get('reported_values')==new['methods'][method].get('reported_values')
    assert old['methods'][method].get('reported_source')==new['methods'][method].get('reported_source')
history=json.loads((evidence/'historical_aggregate_sha256.json').read_text())
for path,value in history['sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==value
for seq in ['01','02','03','04','05','06','08','09','10']:
    assert json.loads((evidence/f'seq_{seq}_complete.json').read_text())['scans_deleted']
for name in ['controller_resume_exit.json','helper_resume_exit.json']:
    assert json.loads((evidence/name).read_text())['exit_code']==0
assert all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in json.loads((evidence/'import_commands.json').read_text()))
assert all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in json.loads((evidence/'regeneration_commands.json').read_text()))
print(json.dumps({'methods':counts,'historical_aggregates_unchanged':len(history['sha256']),
                  'paper_reference_values_and_sources_unchanged':True},indent=2))
